# catalyst_filestore_folders (Data Source)

List existing File Store folders. Requires `ZohoCatalyst.folders.READ`. It does not download files or create folders. Results are sorted lexicographically by ID. An empty project returns an empty list; denied access or malformed responses return an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "catalyst_filestore_folders" "example" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

output "folders" {
  value = data.catalyst_filestore_folders.example.folders
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Existing project's positive numeric ID, written as a string.

### Read-Only

- `folders` (Attributes List) Existing infrastructure, sorted by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folders))

<a id="nestedatt--folders"></a>
### Nested Schema for `folders`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Numeric ID represented as a string without loss of precision.
- `name` (String) Name reported by Catalyst.
